version: Company, fiscal timing and sample audit; supersedes initial restricted-sample estimates
specification: Future annual change in EMP, XSGA, SALE or OIADP scaled by current assets; first fiscal-quarter active-posting change scaled by current assets and sign-ranked 0,.25,.5,.75,1. Controls: current annual changes in the four outcomes, CAPX, XRD, XAD scaled by prior assets, plus book-to-market. SIC2 and year effects; firm-clustered errors with finite-cluster correction and firm-minus-one t inference.
winsorization: Continuous financial variables at pooled 1st/99th percentiles, fixed before complete-case outcomes; predictor rank cutoffs fixed on eligible direct-linked predictor universe.
review_score: Unchanged saved original empirical-Bayes score, all observed reviews, December 31 financial ends. Full-history prior is a timing limitation. Calendar raw-share sensitivity avoids the prior. Additional fiscal raw shares reassign unchanged original raw labels with explicit day-first dates; this changes retained-review coverage as well as timing.
matching: Direct corroborated GVKEY/CIK or prior audited financial identifier. Review identity uses Glassdoor company ID to unique RCID to financial ID, with name corroboration. No current-parent-only or name-only primary posting links. Ambiguous brand/operating/holding entities excluded; canonical issuer review folder used where corroborated.
dates: Posting day included, removal day excluded; missing removal censored at source observation boundary. Only observed full posting windows from 2016 onward. Consecutive fiscal periods lasting 330–400 days; ambiguous financial-year duplicates excluded.
missingness: No zero filling of review years, R&D or advertising. Core-control variants omit R&D/advertising transparently.
book_to_market: Primary CEQ/(CSHO*PRCC_F); WRDS shareholder-equity hierarchy sensitivity. Does not claim access to original author implementation.

coverage.rule: Month count <10% of surrounding 13-month median, requiring at least 6 observed months. Each first-quarter window and its 180-day inventory lookback must avoid flagged months and pre-2016 coverage. Defined before corrected-universe regression estimates.

interpretation: Employment, SG&A and revenue baseline relationships reproduced in broad later-period Indeed sample; earnings not reproduced. Primary original-review interactions remain inconclusive. Coverage-subset earnings interaction is conditional supplementary evidence, not primary validation.
search_disclosure: Corrected checks follow an already-observed exploratory search. All outcomes and variants retained; Holm adjustments apply within each four-outcome family, not the entire search.
